usages.explain: Used together with time-related words to emphasize that a new state has occurred after some time has passed since a certain event.

examples.content: アメリカへ来て、まだ三ヶ月だ。
examples.transcription: あめりかへきて、まださんかげつだ。
examples.mean: It's only been three months since I came to America.

examples.content: まだ半時間だけ働いているのに、もう疲れる気がした。
examples.transcription: まだはんじかんだけはたらいているのに、もうつかれるきがした。
examples.mean: Even though I had only been working for half an hour, I felt like I was already tired.
